newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia foreign reserves at $10.22 bln record.
newsitem.headline: Colombia foreign reserves at $10.22 bln record.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves rose to a new record-high of $10.22 billion as of May 30, the latest date for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
It said net reserves increased by $16.2 million from May 23-30 and by $225 million during the entire month.
Since December 30, according to official Banco de la Republica figures, net reserves have risen by $324.2 million against bank forecasts of a $750 million increase by year-end.
